in_hebrew.name: חלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'חלה' (chalah), meaning 'affliction, sickness', which was a common name for women in biblical times, as seen in the book of Exodus.

in_greek.name: Χαλλά
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Χαλλά' (Challá), meaning 'strong, firm', which was used as a masculine name in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Halla
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Halla', meaning 'noble, bright', which was used as a feminine name in the early Christian church.
